subject: Post-term one-time usage adjustment and closure
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex.park@finflow.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-term usage spike — one-time settlement request

Connor —

We just completed an internal audit for March usage and found a late backfill that ran 3/25–3/31 which pushed us ~220k tokens over our committed capacity for the month. This was after our renewal effective 3/1, so we understand this is technically a post-term true-up.

Could you confirm next steps for a one-time settlement? Based on our initial math the incremental charge would be ~$3,780 before tax. I attached the raw export (usage_report_Mar25-31_2027.csv) with daily token counts.

We'd like to close this quickly — please advise the invoicing flow, whether you can issue an amended invoice or a one-off charge, and what documentation you need from our side.

Thanks,
Alex Park
Billing Lead | FinFlow Payments
alex.park@finflow.com
[Attachment: usage_report_Mar25-31_2027.csv]

From: connor.obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@finflow.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-term usage spike — one-time settlement request

Alex — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the export. I’m looping in Marissa from CS to validate the usage and Ben in Finance for the invoicing path. Quick notes:

- We can handle this as a one-time post-term adjustment (pro-forma invoice) and do a Net30 unless you request immediate charge.
- Accepting documentation: the CSV you sent is good; if we need, Marissa may ask for a short audit log snippet to show the backfill window.
- Timeline proposal: confirmation of the final amount by EOD 4/13, pro-forma issued 4/16, invoice cleared by your PO or payment by 4/30.

Marissa — can you validate the highlighted dates in the CSV and confirm whether there are any platform anomalies (e.g., duplicate jobs) that should be flagged?
Ben — once Marissa confirms, can Finance prepare an amended invoice and (optionally) apply a goodwill adjustment if appropriate?

I’ll keep this thread as the single source of truth.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@finflow.com>, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-term usage spike — one-time settlement request

Alex / Connor — I pulled the call logs and platform audit for 3/25–3/31. The spike you see matches a set of scheduled batch jobs that were inadvertently re-triggered after your renewal cutover. No platform-side billing duplication was found beyond those runs; the token counts in your CSV line up with our logs.

Attached is an export of the audit snippet (audit_snippet_mar25-31.txt). Based on customer history, we recommend treating this as a post-term true-up and issuing a one-time invoice. Given the operational nature (backfill after deployment), I suggest Redwood extend a 10% goodwill courtesy on the overage amount to preserve the relationship. If Finance agrees, that would reduce your out-of-pocket amount.

Action items I recommend:
- Finance prepares amended pro-forma for one-time charge (Ben)
- Customer provides PO (Alex) or confirms Net30 billing
- CS will add a safeguard rule to alert on batch/throughput spikes and share the rule with FinFlow to avoid recurrence

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk the logs.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: audit_snippet_mar25-31.txt]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com, Alex Park <alex.park@finflow.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-term usage spike — one-time settlement request

All — thanks for the validation, Marissa. Finance reviewed the raw numbers and applied the suggested 10% courtesy. Original incremental charge calculated: $3,636.00. After 10% courtesy discount: $3,272.40 (pre-tax).

We will issue a pro-forma invoice (proforma_invoice_FIN-20270416-4882.pdf) with a one-time line item labeled "Post-term usage true-up (Mar 25–31, 2027)". Terms: Net30. If FinFlow prefers immediate charge, we can provide a card link; otherwise please provide PO or billing contact to route the invoice.

Please confirm:
- Billing contact / PO number to place on the invoice
- Whether you want tax applied on your side or we should calculate local sales tax

I will schedule pro-forma for generation on 2027-04-16 once we have a PO or confirmation.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
[Attachment: proforma_invoice_FIN-20270416-4882.pdf]

Samantha (cc) to confirm payment cadence — we anticipate Net30.

Alex / Team — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the PO. Summary and next steps: 

1) Finance will issue pro-forma invoice FIN-20270416-4882 for $3,272.40 (pre-tax) with PO FF-77821 and Net30 terms — Ben will confirm when it’s sent.
